text:
sam: Planning to enable model v2.1-alpha in the catalog tonight at 22:00 UTC. Need fallback ordering and pin guidance. Canary 5% for 30m to start. @jess can you sign off on fallback ladder? cc @miguel @taylor

jess: Sounds good. What’s the intended fallback ladder — v2.1-alpha -> v2.0-stable -> v1.9-quant? Or do we prefer v2.0-quant before v1.9?

miguel: Recommend: v2.1-alpha (canary) -> v2.0-quant -> v2.0-stable -> v1.9. Quant gives cost win and is architecture-compatible. We should watch quality deltas closely.

taylor: Agree with miguel. Also add a TTL on fallback of 2 minutes to avoid oscillation during transient errors. And pin heavy routes: /chat-stream should stay on v2.0-stable until canary proves stable for latency.

sam: Notes for rollout: canary schedule 5% -> 20% after 1h if p50 latency < 60ms and error_rate < 0.5%. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 1% or clear quality regression on sampled evals. We'll run perf tests during the canary window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduling catalog enable: model=v2.1-alpha, canary=5%, window=2024-10-17T22:00:00Z. Rollout ID: r-1734567890. Runbook: https://internal/release/r-1734567890

jess: Copy. I'll assemble a small prompt set for quick evals and watch hallucination deltas. I’ll also monitor token usage; if cost per request increases >10% we consider reverting the quant fallback.

miguel: Pasting suggested config snippet for fallback ordering and pins:
```
fallback_order:
  - v2.1-alpha
  - v2.0-quant
  - v2.0-stable
  - v1.9
fallback_ttl_seconds: 120
pins:
  - route: /chat-stream
    pinned_model: v2.0-stable
canary:
  percent: 5
  step_up_after: 30m
  step_to: 20
```

taylor: One more ask: enable route-level pinning for embeddings endpoints as well. Embeddings are sensitive and we don’t want silent drift there.

sam: I’ll publish the release notes and hook up console alerts and an automated rollback job if canary metrics breach thresholds. Anyone object? If not I’ll flip the switch at 22:00 UTC.

jess: :thumbsup: go ahead. I’ll be on-call for the first 90m.

miguel: :shipit:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout r-1734567890 started. canary=5%. status=IN_PROGRESS
